title: Beau Lamarre-Condon used his service weapon to murder two men. Did NSW police recruiters miss any red flags?
summary_full: Video of convicted double murderer shows him in 2020 deploying a Taser at close range to an Indigenous man’s face, chest and neckGet our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastBeau Lamarre-Condon, the double murderer who killed Jesse Baird and Luke Davies while he was a serving New South Wales police officer, had been under review by the force for repeatedly using his Taser on a man four years before the killings.On Wednesday, he was convicted after a 12-person jury found he had murdered both men with his police service weapon on 19 February 2024.
